heading.en: How much does the sample mean wobble?

hook.en: Ten students each pick 25 bags of rice from a godown and weigh them. Their ten averages will not agree. The spread of these averages, the *standard error*, tells us how far we can trust a single sample.
hook.kn: ಹತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಗೋದಾಮಿನಿಂದ ತಲಾ 25 ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಚೀಲಗಳನ್ನು ತೂಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವರ ಹತ್ತು ಸರಾಸರಿಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಸರಾಸರಿಗಳ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆ, ಅಂದರೆ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ದೋಷ, ಒಂದು ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ಎಷ್ಟು ನಂಬಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Define standard error and state its uses
Use SE formulas for mean, proportion and their differences

say.en: Ten students each pick 25 bags of rice from a godown and weigh them. Their ten averages will not agree. The spread of these averages, the standard error, tells us how far we can trust a single sample. In this lesson: Define a sampling distribution.
Define standard error and state its uses.
Use SE formulas for mean, proportion and their differences.

body.en: The values of a statistic from all possible samples of the same size, with their probabilities (or frequencies), form its *sampling distribution*. The mean of the sampling distribution of $\bar{x}$ is $\mu$. The standard deviation of the sampling distribution of a statistic is called its standard error (SE).
body.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಗಾತ್ರದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾದರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿಯ ಬೆಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆಗಳು ಅದರ ಮಾದರಿ ವಿತರಣೆ. ಅದರ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ವಿಚಲನೆಯೇ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ದೋಷ.

narration.en: The teacher lists all samples of size 2 from {2, 4, 6}, draws the distribution of the sample mean and finds its standard error.

say.en: Population: 2, 4 and 6. Its mean is 4 and its variance is 8 by 3.
Draw samples of size 2 with replacement: 9 samples. Write their means.
Count the means: 2 once, 3 twice, 4 three times, 5 twice, 6 once. Draw the bars.
The mean of the sample means is 4, the same as mu. Their variance is 4 by 3, which is sigma squared over n.
So the standard error of the mean is sigma over root n.

Their histogram centres on micro equals 3.5 and narrows as n grows: its standard deviation, the standard error, is sigma divided by the square root of n with sigma equals 1.708.

body.en: $SE(\bar{x}) = \sigma/\sqrt{n}$; $SE(p) = \sqrt{PQ/n}$; $SE(\bar{x}_1 - \bar{x}_2) = \sqrt{\sigma_1^2/n_1 + \sigma_2^2/n_2}$; $SE(p_1 - p_2) = \sqrt{P_1Q_1/n_1 + P_2Q_2/n_2}$. Uses: SE measures the reliability of an estimate, is used to build confidence limits ($\bar{x} \pm 1.96\, SE$ at 95%), and is the denominator of every large-sample test statistic.
body.kn: SE(x̄) = σ/√n; SE(p) = √(PQ/n); ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳು: ಅಂದಾಜಿನ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ, ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ ಮಿತಿಗಳು, ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿಯ ಛೇದ.

narration.en: SE(x-bar) = sigma/rootn; SE(p) = rootPQ/n; SE(x-bar_1 - x-bar_2) = rootsigma_1^2/n_1 + sigma_2^2/n_2; SE(p_1 - p_2) = rootP_1Q_1/n_1 + P_2Q_2/n_2. Uses: SE measures the reliability of an estimate, is used to build confidence limits (x-bar ± 1.96, SE at 95%), and is the denominator of every large-sample test statistic.
narration.kn: SE(x̄) = σ/√n; SE(p) = √(PQ/n); ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳು: ಅಂದಾಜಿನ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ, ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ ಮಿತಿಗಳು, ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿಯ ಛೇದ.

say.en: SE(x-bar) equals sigma/rootn; SEp equals rootPQ/n; SE(x-bar 1 - x-bar 2) equals rootsigma 1 to the power 2 over n 1 plus sigma 2 to the power 2 over n 2; SE(p 1 - p 2) equals rootP 1Q 1 over n 1 plus P 2Q 2 over n 2. Uses: SE measures the reliability of an estimate, is used to build confidence limits (x-bar plus or minus 1.96, SE at 95 percent), and is the denominator of every large-sample test statistic. SE falls as n grows (like 1/ the square root of n).
say.kn: SE(x̄) equals sigma divided by the square root of n; SEp equals the square root of (PQ over n); ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳು: ಅಂದಾಜಿನ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ, ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ ಮಿತಿಗಳು, ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿಯ ಛೇದ.

problem.en: A population has s.d. 20. Find the standard error of the mean for samples of size 100 and of size 400.

steps.en: Four times the sample halves the standard error.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A population has s.d. 20. Find the standard error of the mean for samples of size 100 and of size 400.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A population has s.d. 20. Find the standard error of the mean for samples of size 100 and of size 400.
SE equals sigma divided by the square root of n.
n equals 100: 20 over 10 equals 2.
n equals 400: 20 over 20 equals 1.
Four times the sample halves the standard error.
So the answer is SE equals 2 and SE equals 1.

problem.en: In a town 40% of households use LPG. Find the SE of the sample proportion for a sample of 150 households.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. In a town 40% of households use LPG. Find the SE of the sample proportion for a sample of 150 households.

say.en: Let us work this out together. In a town 40 percent of households use LPG. Find the SE of the sample proportion for a sample of 150 households.
P equals 0.4, Q equals 0.6, n equals 150.
SEp equals the square root of (PQ over n) equals the square root of (0.24 over 150) equals the square root of 0.0016.
SEp equals 0.04.
So the answer is SEp equals 0.04.
